acceptance: One documented command (or workflow_dispatch workflow) takes a verified fork wheel, adopts it, runs the retirement and baseline checks, and prepares the BenchBox change for a PR.
It refuses unverified or dirty wheels and does not publish anything.
Covered by a test using a fixture wheel.
description: Fork-side refresh is tooled (downstream.refresh candidate/integrate, make benchbox-dist/benchbox-check) and the freshness gate now blocks releases when upstream is ahead. Adopting the new wheel in BenchBox is still manual: build and verify the wheel, run scripts.sync_sqlglot_runtime --wheel, update the runtime baseline, and open a PR. Nothing opens the refresh PR or drives these steps in order.
